Messages.Author: kushiel
Messages.Body:
Does Mask "track" its own uses? In other words, if I have two vampires with
Obfuscate untapped, can I cycle an infinite amount of Masks by continuing to
have the vampire who is currently untapped play a Mask? Or does the "only one
of a given action modifier card may per played per action" rule somehow track
whether or not a vampire has played a Mask during the current action? Thanks.

Kushiel

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The "only one of a given action modifier card may be play by a given minion in
a given action" rule explicitly tracks whether a vampire has played a Mask
during the current action.

To help Clarify, Section 6.2
" Also remember that the SAME MINION cannot play the same action modifier or
reaction card more than once per action. "

So Vamp A takes an action, Vamp B Masks to take it over. Vamp A can then
Mask to take it back over. Vamp A & B can no longer play mask during this
action. If you had Vamp C, he could take over, etc...

David the Demon Hunter
